changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment: Store lead time consumption on a material: the quantity expected to be consumed over the supplier's lead time. The material create and edit forms take it as a labelled input and the client uses it to recompute the minimum stock, reorder level and maximum stock, so the derived numbers were persisted while the input behind them was not. Reopening the form therefore recomputed from a blank field. DOUBLE and nullable, matching min_stock, max_stock, safety_stock, reorder_level, moq and opening_stock, which are the levels it is derived into and are held in the same unit.
